recentItems.title: The Official Stan Lee Podcast Episode 5 | Nuff Said. A Roundtable Debate.
recentItems.description:
Stan Lee, Marvel, and modern pop culture are of course beloved, but to many die-hard fans they can also be controversial. This episode puts nostalgia aside and opens the floor to a wide-ranging round-table debate on some of the most talked-about, uncomfortable, and controversial questions surrounding Stan Lee, modern Marvel, and the current state of pop culture. With no single "right answer," the hosts challenge assumptions, test long-held beliefs, and explore whether pop culture is evolving, stagnating, or simply changing with the times.

recentItems.title: The Official Stan Lee Podcast Episode 4 | From Comics to Controllers: Stan Lee and Video Games
recentItems.description:
Video games are now one of the most powerful storytelling mediums in pop culture, but the DNA of great characters didn't start with controllers. Stan Lee's philosophies, creator practices, and legendary characters helped shape the way video games tell stories, build heroes, and connect emotionally with players. Joined by legendary voice actor, Charles Martinet (the voice of Mario and Luigi), the conversation dives into how personality, optimism, and humanity make characters endure across generations and platforms.

recentItems.title: The Official Stan Lee Podcast Episode 3 | Stan Steals the Scene: The Story Behind the Cameos
recentItems.description:
For millions of fans, no Marvel movie felt complete until Stan Lee made his signature cameo appearance. Whether he was offering advice in Mallrats, delivering a FedEx package, or popping up in nearly every chapter of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Stan's cameos became a beloved tradition and a wink to audiences around the world. Our five hosts tackle how the cameos began, why fans loved them, and what they reveal about Stan's unique connection with his audience. Expect discussion about the overall best Stan cameos, theories about Stan's characters, and debate about if Stan should have a place in the MCU after his passing.

recentItems.description:
107 Obsession Facts YOU Should Know!

Be careful what you wish for! People have been saying this for quite some time, but I don’t know if it has ever been so very visceral. Obsession is the year’s biggest horror movie, which is especially surprising when other notable releases have included Backrooms, Evil Dead, and 28 Years Later. Folks just can’t get enough of this nasty, mean-spirited indie. And with that in mind, we’ve collected 107 frightful facts about the production, the cast, the crew, and more! So check your drivers-side window, and maybe journal a little bit about your wishes, because we’re about to take over your mind with something otherworldly.
